map.面积和周长单位为何不同？: Why do area and circumference have different units?
map.面积是二维量用平方单位（m²），周长是一维量用长度单位（m）；二者量纲不同不可直: Area is a two-dimensional quantity in square units (m²) while circumference is a one-dimensional quantity in length units (m); the dimensions differ and cannot be added directly. This tool outputs them separately to avoid confusion.
map.：例：r=5m → A=π×25=78.5398 m²、C=2π×5=31.41: : example: r=5m → A=π×25=78.5398 m², C=2π×5=31.4159m. With r=10m → A=314.1593 m² (doubling the radius quadruples the area, matching the square law).
map.：算法：圆面积 A = π·r²，并同时输出周长 C = 2π·r 便于交叉校核: : algorithm: circle area A = π·r², with circumference C = 2π·r also output for cross-checking. r may be any positive length unit and the area unit becomes the corresponding square unit (m→m²). Requires r>0.
